relationships.subject: AP-5
relationships.evidence_quote: Bath application of NMDAR inhibitor AP-5 effectively blocks the induction of post-LTP via different protocols in the ACC.

relationships.subject: zeta inhibitory peptide
relationships.evidence_quote: The application of a PKMζ inhibitor, zeta inhibitory peptide (ZIP), has been shown to completely abolish LTP in the ACC.

relationships.subject: ASIC1a
relationships.evidence_quote: Recently, Li et al. demonstrated that acid-sensing ion channel 1a (ASIC1a) in excitatory neurons of ACC contributed to cortical TBS-induced LTP and chronic pain.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Another way to induce LTP is the chemical bath application of substances such as glycine, calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP), or brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) [40].

relationships.subject: AC1
relationships.evidence_quote: Genetically knocking out AC1 or applying AC1 inhibitor NB001 blocked the pre-LTP in the IC [65].

key_findings: Review of thalamus, ACC and insular cortex circuits and pre/post-synaptic LTP/LTD mechanisms in chronic neuropathic pain.
Plasticity-related molecules (NMDAR, AC1, PKMζ, ASIC1a, GluA1) proposed as drug targets.
